services.name: Escape Rooms
services.desc: Take a look at our Arlington, TX escape rooms! Escape the pirate ship before the bomb goes off, or explore a haunted Victorian mansion to solve the mysteries of Edgar Allen Poe. Explore our escape room pages and when you find the challenge that's right for you, book your reservation

blurb: Guests participate in themed escape room challenges where they solve puzzles and find clues to escape within one hour. Themes include a pirate ship, haunted Victorian mansion, and Area 51 sci-fi adventure. They also offer rage rooms for 20 minutes of smashing breakable objects.
extraNote: Call or leave voicemail for reservations or questions; responses in order received · 2111 N Collins St #225 Arlington TX 76011
